title: Eyes on WB Games & HBO Max: What's Next?
text:
2025-06-19 00:13:00
Sony Eyes Warner Bros. Discovery Acquisition? Rumors swirl that Sony might acquire Warner Bros. Discovery’s Streaming & Studios unit, including HBO Max and WB Games.
Sony is rumored to be negotiating a major acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery’s Streaming & Studios unit. The deal could reshape the gaming and streaming landscape, potentially leading to PlayStation exclusives. Sources suggest Sony is primarily interested in the streaming and gaming assets, not the debt-laden cable networks. Could Sony be on the verge of a blockbuster deal? According to recent reports, Sony is reportedly in talks to acquire Warner Bros. Discovery’s (WBD) Streaming & Studios company. This potential move, if true, would reshape the gaming and streaming industries, as Sony would gain ownership of HBO Max and WB Games.
The rumor originated from SEScoops, a wrestling news site, causing some skepticism, but the news has caused ripples of speculation. Currently, Warner Bros. Discovery is undergoing a significant restructuring, with plans to split into two entities by mid-2026. One part will be WBD Global Networks, which encompasses cable channels such as CNN, TNT, and TBS. The other will be WBD Streaming & Services, which includes streaming (HBO Max), studio, and gaming businesses, including WB Games.
Sources indicate that Sony is particularly interested in WBD’s streaming and gaming assets, while apparently avoiding the company’s cable network business, which is reportedly burdened with debt. The current CEO of Warner Bros. Discovery, David Zaslav, is expected to lead WBD Streaming and Studios, though his future under a potential Sony acquisition remains uncertain.
Acquiring New Goodies Gotham Knights l Image Credit: WB Games If the deal goes through, Sony would acquire HBO Max, a large collection of intellectual properties (IPs), and the assets of WB Games. This would give Sony significant ownership over iconic franchises like Batman, Harry Potter, Game of Thrones, and Mortal Kombat.
The acquisition could include studios like Avalanche Software (Hogwarts Legacy), NetherRealm Studios (Mortal Kombat, Injustice), Rocksteady Studios (Batman Arkham series), TT Games (LEGO games), and WB Games Montréal (Batman Arkham Origins, Gotham Knights).
For Sony, this move aligns with its strategy to diversify its portfolio and expand its multimedia empire, which already boasts IPs like Spider-Man, God of War, and Uncharted. However, this substantial acquisition raises many questions.
Monopoly and Competition Wonder Woman opening scene | Image credit: HBO Max/YouTube Merging two of Hollywood’s major studios could trigger regulatory scrutiny on competition grounds. Another key consideration is whether WB Games titles would become PlayStation exclusives.
While some gamers would be thrilled with PlayStation exclusives, many believe that Sony would prioritize multiplatform releases for popular titles like Mortal Kombat and Hogwarts Legacy to maximize revenue, especially with Sony recently investing in releasing first-party titles on PC. Others point out that some AAA titles have struggled financially as exclusives.
Financial and Management Challenges Acquiring WBD’s assets could be an incredibly expensive endeavor. WBD has also faced its share of instability, including studio closures and game flops. Sony and WB Games’ leadership have also made missteps, resulting in layoffs. This raises questions about the long-term benefits and whether Sony is prepared for the financial and operational challenges.
Final Thoughts Given that the source is SEScoops, a wrestling news site, skepticism is advised. The rumor, while fitting with Sony’s profile, remains unconfirmed. It’s unclear if either Sony or WBD is interested in pursuing this deal. Many believe that WB Games needs better leadership to succeed independently rather than a capital infusion.
